resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the removal only as 'Mid-1970's', and its description says the lookout was in use until the early 1970s. The story follows the register's mid-1970s wording.

notes_for_editor: Only one register page carries the lookout's history (built 1967, mobile R1M trailer, removal 'Mid-1970's'). Searches and reads found no staffing, fire record, or current-site description. Elevation conflict on the register page: the header gives 8,849 ft (2,697 m), which matches the record's 2697.2 m, while the description gives 8,420 ft; the record's figure was kept. The Forest Lookouts page reproduces a 1972 Caltrans survey description with driving directions through a wire gate; directions are deliberately left out of the story. The 1975 removal year is a midpoint placeholder for 'Mid-1970's', not a dated record. No photo was added: the 1969 image URL was not in the cached text.
